description: Ready-to-send request messages for manual gRPC testing of cashier.v1.CashierService (grpcurl or Postman). Replace the <PLACEHOLDERS>. Schema: cashier-service.grpc.schema.json. Never commit a real service key.

placeholders.<TENANT_ID>: UUID of an active tenant with F&B enabled and some products/orders
placeholders.<OTHER_TENANT_ID>: UUID of a different active tenant (isolation checks)
placeholders.<USER_ID>: UUID of an ACTIVE staff user with an active membership in <TENANT_ID> and access to at least one active outlet
placeholders.<OUTSIDER_USER_ID>: UUID of an existing staff user without an active membership in <TENANT_ID> (or with a deactivated membership, or only inactive outlets)
placeholders.<ORDER_NUMBER>: an existing order number of <TENANT_ID> in an outlet <USER_ID> can access
placeholders.<OTHER_OUTLET_ORDER_NUMBER>: an existing order number of <TENANT_ID> in an outlet <USER_ID> has no access to
placeholders.<OTHER_TENANT_ORDER_NUMBER>: an existing order number that belongs to <OTHER_TENANT_ID>
placeholders.<OWNER_USER_ID>: UUID of an ACTIVE staff user with an ACTIVE OWNERMERCHANT membership in <TENANT_ID> and access to at least one active outlet; used as user_id for the owner-only RPCs
placeholders.<CASHIER_USER_ID>: UUID of an ACTIVE CASHIER member of <TENANT_ID> (valid for GetCatalogItem and GetOrderStatus, rejected by the owner-only RPCs)

GetCatalogItem.name: search by name or category
GetCatalogItem.expect: OK, at most 5 items matching name or category

GetCatalogItem.name: search is case-insensitive and trimmed
GetCatalogItem.expect: OK, same items as the lowercase query

GetCatalogItem.name: LIKE wildcards are escaped
GetCatalogItem.expect: OK, empty items (a literal percent sign, not match-all)

GetCatalogItem.name: blank tenant
GetCatalogItem.expect: INVALID_ARGUMENT: tenant_id must not be blank

GetCatalogItem.name: tenant is not a UUID
GetCatalogItem.expect: INVALID_ARGUMENT: tenant_id must be a valid UUID

GetCatalogItem.name: unknown tenant
GetCatalogItem.expect: PERMISSION_DENIED: Tenant is not permitted for this service (same message as an inactive tenant)

GetCatalogItem.name: missing user_id
GetCatalogItem.expect: INVALID_ARGUMENT: user_id must not be blank

GetCatalogItem.name: user_id is not a UUID
GetCatalogItem.expect: INVALID_ARGUMENT: user_id must be a valid UUID

GetCatalogItem.name: user is not an active member of the tenant
GetCatalogItem.expect: PERMISSION_DENIED: Tenant is not permitted for this service (same message as an unknown tenant)

GetCatalogItem.name: unknown user
GetCatalogItem.expect: PERMISSION_DENIED: Tenant is not permitted for this service

GetOrderStatus.name: existing order
GetOrderStatus.expect: OK with status (OPEN, COMPLETED or CANCELLED), paymentStatus, total (decimal string with 2 decimals, e.g. 36000.00), createdAt (UTC ISO-8601)

GetOrderStatus.name: tenant isolation: order of another tenant
GetOrderStatus.expect: NOT_FOUND (must never return the other tenant's order)

GetOrderStatus.name: outlet scoping: order of an outlet the user cannot access
GetOrderStatus.expect: NOT_FOUND (same tenant, but outside the user's outlets)

GetOrderStatus.name: user is not an active member of the tenant
GetOrderStatus.expect: PERMISSION_DENIED: Tenant is not permitted for this service

GetOrderStatus.name: missing user_id
GetOrderStatus.expect: INVALID_ARGUMENT: user_id must not be blank

GetOrderStatus.name: blank order number
GetOrderStatus.expect: INVALID_ARGUMENT: order_number must not be blank

GetOrderStatus.name: missing order number
GetOrderStatus.expect: INVALID_ARGUMENT: order_number must not be blank

GetOrderStatus.name: blank tenant
GetOrderStatus.expect: INVALID_ARGUMENT: tenant_id must not be blank

GetSalesSummary.name: owner, valid request
GetSalesSummary.expect: OK, one entry per owner outlet, money as plain decimal strings, int64 counts, top_products at most 5; numbers equal the REST owner sales report for the same outlet and range

GetSalesSummary.name: cashier is rejected (owner only)
GetSalesSummary.expect: PERMISSION_DENIED: Tenant is not permitted for this service (identical to an unknown tenant, no existence evidence)

GetSalesSummary.name: user is not an active member of the tenant
GetSalesSummary.expect: PERMISSION_DENIED: Tenant is not permitted for this service (identical to an unknown tenant, no existence evidence)

GetSalesSummary.name: unknown tenant
GetSalesSummary.expect: PERMISSION_DENIED: Tenant is not permitted for this service (identical to an unknown tenant, no existence evidence)

GetSalesSummary.name: tenant isolation: owner of another tenant
GetSalesSummary.expect: PERMISSION_DENIED: Tenant is not permitted for this service (identical to an unknown tenant, no existence evidence); never returns the other tenant's data

GetSalesSummary.name: missing user_id
GetSalesSummary.expect: INVALID_ARGUMENT: user_id must not be blank

GetSalesSummary.name: blank tenant
GetSalesSummary.expect: INVALID_ARGUMENT: tenant_id must not be blank

GetSalesSummary.name: single day
GetSalesSummary.expect: OK, start_date equals end_date in the response

GetSalesSummary.name: start_date missing
GetSalesSummary.expect: INVALID_ARGUMENT: start_date must not be blank

GetSalesSummary.name: end_date is not an ISO date
GetSalesSummary.expect: INVALID_ARGUMENT: end_date must be an ISO date (yyyy-MM-dd)

GetRestockSuggestions.expect: OK, per outlet only active ingredients with suggested_quantity > 0 or stock_status NEGATIVE/OUT/LOW, ordered NEGATIVE, OUT, LOW, OK then name; quantities with up to 3 decimals

GetRestockSuggestions.name: cashier is rejected (owner only)

GetRestockSuggestions.name: missing user_id
GetRestockSuggestions.expect: INVALID_ARGUMENT: user_id must not be blank

GetRestockSuggestions.expect: INVALID_ARGUMENT: tenant_id must not be blank

GetAnomalies.name: owner, valid request
GetAnomalies.expect: OK, per outlet the CASHIER members whose day value exceeds 2 x their 30-day daily average and the minimum (CANCELLATIONS >= 3, DISCOUNTS >= 3, CASH_DIFFERENCE >= 20000); owners are never listed; anomalies may be empty

GetAnomalies.expect: PERMISSION_DENIED: Tenant is not permitted for this service (identical to an unknown tenant, no existence evidence)

GetAnomalies.expect: PERMISSION_DENIED: Tenant is not permitted for this service (identical to an unknown tenant, no existence evidence)

GetAnomalies.expect: PERMISSION_DENIED: Tenant is not permitted for this service (identical to an unknown tenant, no existence evidence)

GetAnomalies.name: date is not an ISO date

authAndLimits.name: no x-internal-service-key header
authAndLimits.expect: UNAUTHENTICATED: Invalid or missing service credentials

authAndLimits.name: burst above 50 requests per second
authAndLimits.expect: Some calls return RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED: Rate limit exceeded
